in_marathi.name: Gyan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gyan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gyan means 'knowledge' or 'wisdom'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jñāna', which refers to the intellectual or spiritual knowledge gained through study or experience. In Hindu mythology, Gyan is considered a sacred and powerful name, often associated with enlightenment and self-realization.
